record_type_quote: The original study was conducted with Israeli active-duty male military members. This replication deviates from the original in that we will use U.S. males with military experience (active duty or veteran).

targets.title: Attachment and leader's development via experiences.
targets.evidence_quote: Testing Popper & Amit’s originally proposed (and retained) model, we found a significant positive relationship between openness to experience and leadership experiences (unstandardized b = 0.164 ; standardized β = .247, p = .001, two tailed).
targets.outcome_quote: We conclude the specified result (a positive relationship between openness to experience and leadership experience) replicated based on the SCORE replication criteria given the beta coefficient from the retained model (see Figure 1) was positive and statistically significant at p = .001.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit verdict confirms the specified claim. Reduced sample and caution do not supersede the authors’ successful replication verdict.
